## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)

Product: 竹知了 (Bamboo Cicada Sound Toy) — a handmade bamboo cicada-shaped sound toy with a cylindrical natural bamboo body, two wing-shaped panels with black vein line illustrations, two round black bead eyes, a red circular cap on top, and a wooden stick handle with two red spherical beads connected by a thin white string.

Reference anchor photos:
- <image 1> (anchor-1-hero.jpg): Hero main-view anchor. Locks the most attractive product view at 3/4 angle with wings spread, red cap visible, and full product form. Use this as the primary identity and color reference for the product throughout the film.
- <image 2> (anchor-2-detail.jpg): Material and functional detail anchor. Locks bamboo surface grain texture, wing panel vein lines, and the red bead and white string connection mechanism. Use this for all close-up material shots.
- <image 3> (anchor-3-copy.jpg): Final copy composition anchor. Locks the final frame product position (right side), Chinese typography layout, single-line text behavior, and two-part color treatment. Use this for the ending frame composition.

Style: Apple-style white-tech product film. Clean pure white background, soft diffused lighting from upper-left, gentle shadow beneath product, no reflective floor, no mirror stage, no glass tables. Impact comes from striking product angles, real product actions, camera rhythm, and negative-space composition. Preserve the exact bamboo beige body color and red accent color throughout — never recolor the product body.

Aspect ratio: 16:9
Duration: 10 seconds
Native audio: ON (generate_audio=true)

Music direction: Around 100 BPM, fast tech feeling, block chords, pluck and airy noise bed, kick + sub-bass + sine sweep, wooden percussion, sudden cut-off, within 0.5s everything stops, leaving only the pluck tail to decay. Techy, Apple-style, product launch feeling. No vocals, no synthwave, no retro, no gaming, no cheap corporate stock music.

Beat-by-beat storyboard:

[Beat 1, 0-1.5s, setup] The film opens on the bamboo body surface at an extreme close-up. Camera slowly pushes in as a natural bamboo grain highlight sweeps from left to right across the surface. The product then rotates smoothly into view from the right side of the frame, revealing its full cicada form. No text in this beat. Transition: the bamboo grain highlight naturally leads the eye to the full product reveal.

[Beat 2, 1.5-3.5s, establish] The full product is now centered in frame at a 3/4 angle. Camera slowly orbits the product, revealing the complete cicada form: cylindrical bamboo body with visible grain, two wing panels with black vein line illustrations, red circular cap on top, two black bead eyes, and the wooden stick with red beads extending to the side. The product is stable and well-lit. No text in this beat. Transition: the orbit naturally brings the camera closer to the string and bead mechanism.

[Beat 3, 3.5-5.5s, prepare] Camera pushes in to a close-up of the white string and red bead connection point on the bamboo body. The red bead slides slightly along the string, creating tension. Shallow depth of field, focus locked on the red bead. At 4.0s, the Chinese copy "一拨即响" fades in on a single line in the vertically centered zone, left-aligned. The first half "一拨" appears first in dark gray, fading in subtly. At 4.5s, the second half "即响" appears in red, fading in subtly. As the second half appears, the first half "一拨" shifts gently to the right within the same line by about 10-15px to make room. The text stays on one line at all times. Transition: the red bead tension naturally builds toward the strike.

[Beat 4, 5.5-7s, impact] The red bead snaps back and strikes the bamboo body surface. The wing panels vibrate visibly in response. The camera holds steady on this moment of energy release. The copy "一拨即响" fades out smoothly by 6.0s. No text for the remainder of this beat. Transition: the wing vibration naturally leads the eye to the wing panel detail.

[Beat 5, 7-8.5s, brake] Camera slowly pushes in to the wing panel surface. The black vein line illustrations are crisp and detailed. The bamboo grain texture shows rich layering under soft light. The wing vibration gradually settles to stillness. No text in this beat. The pace slows down, creating a quiet braking moment. Transition: the camera slowly pulls back from the wing detail to the final composition.

[Beat 6, 8.5-10s, settle] Camera slowly pulls back to the final wide composition. The product settles into the right-center of the frame, matching the position in <image 3>. The left side opens up to generous negative space. At 9.0s, the final Chinese copy "竹韵蝉鸣" fades in on a single line in the vertically centered zone, left-aligned. The first half "竹韵" appears first in dark gray, fading in subtly. At 9.5s, the second half "蝉鸣" appears in red, fading in subtly. As the second half appears, the first half "竹韵" shifts gently to the right within the same line by about 10-15px to make room. The text stays on one line at all times. The final frame holds stable with the product and copy visible. This is the ending frame.

Typography hard constraints:
- All in-frame copy is Chinese text.
- At any moment, only one single-line copy line may appear in the frame. Never show two rows, two-line titles, title plus subtitle pairs, or multiple text blocks at the same time.
- Copy line 1: "一拨即响" — appears at 4.0s, first half "一拨" in dark gray (#333333), second half "即响" in red (#D32F2F). First half fades in first, second half fades in 0.5s later, first half shifts right 10-15px within the same line.
- Copy line 2: "竹韵蝉鸣" — appears at 9.0s, first half "竹韵" in dark gray (#333333), second half "蝉鸣" in red (#D32F2F). First half fades in first, second half fades in 0.5s later, first half shifts right 10-15px within the same line.
- Font: clean modern sans-serif Chinese typeface, similar to PingFang SC Semibold or SF Pro Display Semibold style.
- Text positioned in the vertically centered visual zone, left-aligned, not in a lower subtitle position. Text should feel like a product-film visual element, not an explanatory subtitle.
- Text motion must be visible: smooth fade-in and subtle horizontal shift. No bouncy, neon, or flashy effects.
- Copy line 1 fades out by 6.0s. Copy line 2 holds until the end of the film.

Product fidelity constraints:
- Preserve the exact natural bamboo beige body color throughout. Never turn the product white, silver, or recolor it.
- The red cap and red beads must remain vivid red in all shots.
- The black vein line illustrations on the wing panels must remain visible and crisp.
- The white string connecting the body to the stick must remain visible in mechanism shots.

Shot continuity constraints:
- Element continuity: the product's form, color, proportions, and details remain consistent across all beats.
- Motion continuity: camera movements flow smoothly between beats with no jarring cuts.
- Form continuity: the product is always recognizable as the same object from the same anchor identity.

Output: One continuous full-frame 16:9 product ad film, 10 seconds, with native audio. Do not show split screens, panels, grids, collage layouts, or storyboard frames at any point. The ending must be a stable single full-frame product closing with the copy "竹韵蝉鸣" visible.
